title: Story 1.4 names a 'retry-restores-clean-state test' as a Golden/edge-case contract; no such test exists
detail: The story lists 'retry-restores-clean-state test' on the same Golden line as the T1/T2 game-over goldens (which ARE present). The restart behavior is implemented (run_destroy+run_init zeroes via state^={}; fresh crypto seed; mode/tick/accum/drag reset) but has zero automated coverage, and the app Mode FSM transitions (Run→Game_Over at main.odin:111, Game_Over→Run via R/Enter at :174) are likewise untested. No behavioral defect is evident — this is a missing spec-named verification artifact, calibrated down from blocker because the restart reads correct + is GUI-path.
recommended_fix: Add a headless test asserting restart resets cleanly: after a terminal run, call run_destroy+run_init on the same state and assert score==0, terminal==false, outcome==.None, events empty, and that a different seed yields a different run. Lift the reset logic into a core proc if needed to test it without raylib.
